{{Vanilla|The End}}
'''The End''' is the dimension of the [[Ender Dragon]]. [[Matcha Flavoured]] keeps its name and terrain, and changes only a few things about it.

== Changes ==
* The water color of the End biomes is changed to <code>#a2b5dd</code>, as in most of the pack's biomes. See [[Biomes]].
* [[End City]] chest loot is changed.
* The [[Wither]] cannot be summoned in The End.
* Killing the Ender Dragon for the first time grants an [[amalgamated pith]], and changes mob spawning on the overworld surface (see [[Surface]]).

{{Planned|source=README.md}}
In the developer's plans, reaching The End will require visiting the main overworld structures, each of which gives a [[Sacred texts|sacred text]] that is traded for the map to the next.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History
|{{History line|0.5-alpha|Fixed a bug that caused a major performance crash in The End.}}
{{History line|1.10|Withers can no longer be spawned in The End.}}
{{History line|1.12.8-beta|date=October 23, 2026|Endermen spawn in the End again. Before, the End biome files kept their spawn list under a key the game does not read, so the End had no natural enderman spawns.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/biome/the_end.json}}</ref>}}
